title: The Gourmet Supremos: The Seashore Strider
description: You once again encounter the Gourmet Supremos near Inazuma's beaches...

dialogs.text: This dish certainly does have a very "Julie"-esque feel to it.
In fact, the first time I saw it, I thought it must've come from Mondstadt. But as it turns out, it's a local specialty instead.
I bet it tastes just as good as its name sounds, Xudong! C'mon, let's make some, please!
We meet again.
Oh, it's you, Traveler! Hehe, see, what did I tell you about us meeting again?
Xudong's picked up a new recipe from the city! It's called Crab Roe Kourayaki. Pretty good name, huh?
It's not that hard to make either. But it does require a great number of crabs...
I've prepared some normal crabs, and now I'm looking for some... special ones.
Special crabs?
Exactly! In specific, we're going for the ones that dwell under that Thunder Sakura!
You might as well say "thunderstruck crabs"...
Well, I'm just curious, you know? I wonder what crabs that live under such circumstances will taste like...
However, with lightning flashing all around that tree, I daren't get too close.
My book states that just like before, you just need to touch a Thunder Sakura Bough and cause an Electrogranum to attach to you...
And that way, you won't be struck by the lightning from the Thunder Sakura.
But well, you've seen what that tree looks like. I'm not going to risk it based off such a rough summary of a solution.
Wouldn't it work if we just ran fast enough?
Are you daft? Do you think you can run faster than lightning!?
Well, why don't we just use a stick to pull those crabs out and stuff...
If you ask me, we might as well dig some ditch nearby. That'll draw both the water and the crabs out.
Hahaha. Everyone's got their own opinion. That's great, that's great!
If you don't mind, Traveler, could you help us catch a few of the crabs that live under that Thunder Sakura?
If you do, I'll whip up a great feast for you as thanks.
Ah, yes. Hang on... Take this bait.
If you're going to catch crabs over there, use these to attract them first.
It should save you some time and effort.
Crabs that live near a Thunder Sakura. I wonder how they'll taste...
Oh, we're talking about delicious food again, are we?

flow.stepDescription: Place bait near the Thunder Sakura

dialogs.text: That book of mine says that if you touch the Thunder Sakura Bough, you won't be hit by any of those lightning bolts around the Thunder Sakura...
But well, you've seen what that tree looks like. I'm not going to risk it based off such a rough summary of a solution.
I wonder if there are any tougher branches nearby...
Hmm, perhaps digging a ditch might take a little too long...

flow.stepDescription: Give the captured crab to Xudong

dialogs.text: Ah, Traveler! How goes the crab-catching harvest?
Oho! This crab looks pretty good. You're a dab hand at this, aren't you?
Well then, since we've got all our ingredients, let's begin cooking post-haste.
Let me prepare for a while, Traveler. Please wait here.
Why do Electrograna have so many uses... how strange...
I wonder how this Crab Roe Kourayaki is going to taste...
Kourayaki... Why is it called Kourayaki, I wonder...
Well, guess we'll make it first and ask questions later.
Aha, here we go! "Crab Roe Kourayaki."
I'll have one! Mm-hmm, this is great!
Give me one of the smaller ones. I doubt I'd be able to finish one that's too large...
And this serving's for you, Traveler.
Here, why don't you have a copy of the recipe, too?
This dish shouldn't be too hard to make, so you can try it yourself if you like.
We'll probably head for the vicinity of <color=#00E1FFFF>Yashiori Island</color> next. Go look for us there, if you've got the time.
Alright, time to grab a bite for myself, eh...
Hey! Julie! Leave one for me!
Why do Electrograna have so many uses... how strange...
I wonder how this Crab Roe Kourayaki is going to taste...
